_comment: Rules for companion source uploads (SPEC-companionPages-102826). mediaTypeByExtension: the file extensions a source may have and the media type each is served with; any other extension is refused by name (lower case, no dot). maxSourceByteSize: the largest decoded file accepted (25 MiB); the upload route's JSON body limit in server/lib/large-body-route-list.json is set above it to allow for base64's 4/3. The name patterns guard every value that becomes part of a stored path.
